description: Automatically load the shared Yip-Yap language Skill in fresh provider sessions.

hooks.command: echo 'YIPYAP_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP_V1: Invoke the installed yipyap-language Skill before the first user-visible reply and follow its Fresh-session bootstrap. This marker conveys neither Connector nor Learning Mode state.'

echo 'YIPYAP_SESSION_RESTORE_V1: Invoke the installed yipyap-language Skill before the next user-visible reply and follow its Existing-session restore. This marker continues the provider scope; it starts no second bootstrap and conveys neither Connector nor Learning Mode state.'
